code_bytes.reason: JS emitter optimizations (#6163) read instance fields as o.name instead of through the hoisted o[_qN] alias table, which V8 can scalar-replace (valueEscape 20% faster). The longer identifiers grow the raw script by 2,453,423 bytes (code and install move by the same amount); gzip absorbs the repetition: the gallery's own wire_bytes, gated at 2%, went 80,131,522 -> 80,155,363 (+0.03%) in the same run. Parse cost scales with the raw size; the opt-in field mangler (mangleInstanceFieldProps) would win it back but is off by default because host-poked fields are not yet enumerated.
